rootReview: Coordinator recoveryOnly is constructed from the actual locked remote-phase journal and bound transaction/material namespace/candidate/owned submission path/device pin. All signing/candidate-read/prepare/submit hooks deny missing signing context before work.

The App keeps startup and foreground local; only the existing explicit authenticated recover path can Lookup or clean the exact owned upload. Unknown Upgrade retains its package and never reuploads or infers renewal from same-version presence.

Actual public configuration, accessible Keychain persistent identity and existing record namespace/peer binding are required. Missing or expired signing materials confer no Vault.Namespace, signing lease or fresh submission authority.

Strict KeychainHelper loadChecked shares the one original query/migration with legacy load, preserves actual read/UTF8/bound/migration errors, and only true item-not-found returns nil. No new queue, credential store or key export.

Successful authenticated recovery stays separate from unavailable signing materials. The final status publish is inside post-recovery error wrapping, preserving actual completedRecovery and the independent local/remote errors.
Five locales append the same footer without modifying prior bytes. Root fixed the newly noticed inner-try macro call in one test; all original fixture assertions and the same six method names remain.

Same-process installed-observation cache and uploadIntent early return remain explicit S6 limitations: every foreground does not fully recheck all expiry/revocation. Real lease use/connect still verifies material, with no renewal or device claims.
